Graph Engine resources

Fields every OpenEngine resource shares. Resources follow Kubernetes conventions: apiVersion and kind say what a document is, metadata identifies it, spec holds what its author wants, and status, where a kind has one, is what the service observed. Applying a resource creates it under a new name and updates it under a known one; status and the service-set metadata fields are ignored on apply. Several resources may share one file, separated by ---.

Validate files with uv run python packages/contracts/tooling/resources.py check FILE… from v2/.

Graph

apiVersion: openengine.cc/v1alpha1 · kind: Graph · defined in graph_engine/v1/resources/graph.schema.yaml

The steps of a piece of work and the flow between them. Steps are written in three stages, plan, implementation and review, which run in that order; each stage's steps run in the order written, and the last goes to end. flow adds only what that order cannot say: joins, branches and loops back. Step names are unique across the whole graph, and start, end and naming are reserved. Cycles must pass through a route, so every loop has a way out, and every step must be reachable and able to reach end.

Example from implement-review.graph.yaml
apiVersion: openengine.cc/v1alpha1
kind: Graph
metadata:
  name: implement-review
  labels:
    team: platform
spec:
  description: Implement an issue, open a pull request, wait for CI, then review it from several angles until nothing actionable is left.
  inputs:
    - name: instruction
      required: true
      description: The change to make
    - name: base
      description: The branch to build on; empty means main
    - name: runner
      default: claude
      choices: [claude, codex]
  workspace:
    baseRef: origin/main
    ref: ${inputs.base}
  naming:
    runner: {name: "${inputs.runner}"}
  implementation:
    - name: implement
      agent:
        runner: {name: "${inputs.runner}"}
        steeringPolicy: AlwaysOpen
        tools: [default.git-subcommand]
        prompt: |
          ${inputs.instruction}

          Findings to address, if any: ${json(outputs.consolidate.findings)}
          CI result, if any: ${json(outputs.ci)}
    - name: publish
      displayName: Open pull request
      agent:
        runner: {sameAs: implement}
        tools: [default.git-subcommand, default.open-pull-request]
        prompt: Push this checkout's commits to a new agent/ branch and open a pull request against ${inputs.base}.
        outputs:
          - {name: pr_url, type: string, required: true, description: the pull request's URL}
    - name: ci
      displayName: CI
      ci: {}
  review:
    - name: reviewers
      displayName: Review
      agent:
        runner: {differentFrom: implement, choices: [claude, codex]}
        facets:
          - {name: security, model: elevated}
          - {name: bugs}
          - name: docs
            displayName: Documentation
            focus: Whether user-facing documentation matches the change.
        prompt: "Review ${outputs.publish.pr_url} for ${item.facet.name}: ${item.facet.focus}"
        outputs:
          - {name: findings, type: findings, required: true}
    - name: consolidate
      agent:
        runner: {sameAs: implement}
        prompt: "Drop duplicates and nitpicks from these reviews: ${json(outputs.reviewers)}"
        outputs:
          - {name: findings, type: findings, required: true, preserveLineage: true}
    - name: approve
      displayName: Human review
      human:
        prompt: Approve ${outputs.publish.pr_url}, or reject it with a note saying what to change.
  flow:
    - from: [ci]
      route:
        - {when: "outputs.ci.passed == false && visits.implement < 4", to: implement}
        - {to: reviewers}
    - from: [consolidate]
      route:
        - {when: "size(outputs.consolidate.findings) > 0 && visits.implement < 3", to: implement}
        - {to: approve}
    - from: [approve]
      route:
        - {when: "outputs.approve.decision == 'rejected' && size(outputs.approve.note) > 0", to: implement}
        - {to: end}

annotationsmap[string]stringFree-form notes for tools and people. Services never act on them.

GraphSpec

What the graph does. At least one stage must have a step.

Set at least one of plan, implementation, review.

FieldTypeDescription
descriptionstringPlain-language description, at most 2000 characters.
Not empty. At most 2000 characters.
inputs[]InputValues a run is given, read as ${inputs.NAME}. Names are unique.
At most 64 items.
workspaceWorkspaceThe checkout every step works in, prepared before the first step. Its commits are what the steps change and what a pull request publishes.
namingNamingGives each run a short name from its instruction, after the checkout. The turn refuses every permission request and cannot change anything. Without it a run is named after its submission.
plan[]StepSteps that decide what to do. They run first.
implementation[]StepSteps that make the change. They run after plan.
review[]StepSteps that check the change. They run last.
flow[]FlowRuleEdges and routes the written order cannot express. Applied in order.

Input

One value a run is given.

Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$.
descriptionstringPlain-language description, at most 2000 characters.
Not empty. At most 2000 characters.
requiredbooleanWhether a run must supply the value. A required input has no default.
Default false.
defaultstringThe value when a run supplies none.
Default ''.
choices[]stringThe only values allowed. default, when given, must be one of them.
At least 1 items. Unique.

The checkout every step works in, prepared before the first step. Its commits are what the steps change and what a pull request publishes.

Default origin/HEAD. Not empty.
refstringThe ref to check out, usually from an input, such as ${inputs.base}. Empty means baseRef.

Naming

Gives each run a short name from its instruction, after the checkout. The turn refuses every permission request and cannot change anything. Without it a run is named after its submission.

runnerrequiredRunnerWhich runner an agent step uses, decided when it runs. Set exactly one of name, sameAs or differentFrom.

Set exactly one of name, sameAs, differentFrom.

AgentStep

An agent session in the workspace. Its result is outputs when they are declared, otherwise the agent's final message.

FieldTypeDescription
runnerrequiredRunnerWhich runner an agent step uses, decided when it runs. Set exactly one of name, sameAs or differentFrom.
modelstringA model tier (cheapest, default, elevated), a model, or a template. Empty means the runner's default tier.
promptrequiredstringWhat the agent is asked to do.
Not empty.
tools[]stringThe tools the agent may call, each as namespace.name. Listing a tool is the grant: once a step attempt has its workspace, and before the attempt is sent to run there, the Graph Engine applies a ToolGrant for each tool to that attempt in that workspace. It deletes them when the attempt ends. The step can call nothing else.
Items: Pattern ^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$. Unique.
outputs[]OutputThe structured result the agent must report. Names are unique.
At most 64 items.
steeringPolicystringAlwaysOpen lets steering, such as a comment on the pull request, re-enter the run at this step after it finished. Default accepts steering only while the step runs.
Default Default. One of Default, AlwaysOpen.
facets[]FacetRun the step once per facet, in parallel. Each run reads its facet as item.facet, and the step's output is the list of every run's output.
At least 1 items. At most 32 items.

Facet

One parallel run of a faceted step. A built-in facet (security, bugs, performance, conciseness, dryness) needs only its name; any other facet gives its focus.

FieldTypeDescription
namerequiredstringThe facet's name, read as item.facet.id.
Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$.
displayNamestringHow the facet is shown, read as item.facet.name. Defaults to the built-in facet's or to name.
Not empty. At most 120 characters.
focusstringWhat this run looks at, read as item.facet.focus. Required for a facet that is not built in.
Not empty.
modelstringA model tier, a model or a template for this run, overriding the step's model.

HumanStep

Waits for a person to approve or reject, with an optional note. The step's output is {decision, note}.

FieldTypeDescription
promptrequiredstringWhat the person is asked to decide.
Not empty.
choosestringAn expression naming findings, such as outputs.reranker.findings. The person then picks which to act on, and the step's output is the findings they picked.
Not empty.

CIStep

Waits for continuous integration on the change's pull request. The step's output is {passed, ...}. Written ci: {}.

No fields.

FlowRule

Where steps go next. A step named in from leaves the written order: it goes only where its rules say. Set exactly one of to or route.

Set exactly one of to, route.

FieldTypeDescription
fromrequired[]stringThe steps the rule leaves, or start for the graph's entry. Two or more wait for all of them, a join.
Items: Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$. At least 1 items. Unique.
to[]stringSteps to go to unconditionally, in parallel, or end.
Items: Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$. At least 1 items. Unique.
route[]RouteA conditional edge. Branches are tried in order and the first whose when holds is taken; the last must have no when, as the default.
At least 1 items.

Route

One branch of a route.

FieldTypeDescription
whenstringThe condition, such as outputs.ci.passed == false && visits.implement < 4. Omitted means always.
Not empty.
torequiredstringThe step to go to, or end.
Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$.

Loop

apiVersion: openengine.cc/v1alpha1 · kind: Loop · defined in graph_engine/v1/resources/loop.schema.yaml

Runs a graph on a schedule: each time the schedule fires, the Graph Engine creates a job from jobTemplate. Suspending or deleting a loop changes only future runs; jobs it already created carry on.

Example from weekday-issues.loop.yaml
apiVersion: openengine.cc/v1alpha1
kind: Loop
metadata:
  name: weekday-issues
spec:
  graphRef:
    name: implement-review
  schedule:
    cron: "0 9-17 * * 1-5"
    timeZone: Europe/Berlin
  startsAt: 2026-11-02T08:00:00Z
  concurrency:
    maxActiveJobs: 2
    overlapPolicy: Queue
  jobTemplate:
    goal: Work the next unblocked issue in the milestone.
    context:
      milestone: CLI e2e tests
    inputs:
      instruction: Work the next unblocked issue in the CLI e2e tests milestone.
      runner: codex
FieldTypeDescription
apiVersionrequiredstringThe API group and version of every resource kind. The version follows the subject namespace: v1alpha1 while oe.v1 is a draft.
Must be openengine.cc/v1alpha1.
kindrequiredstring
Must be Loop.
metadatarequiredObjectMetaIdentifies a resource that is not namespaced (Graph, Loop, Connection). The service sets everything else about it, such as its revision and timestamps.
specrequiredLoopSpecWhat the loop runs and when.

LoopSpec

What the loop runs and when.

FieldTypeDescription
graphRefrequiredGraphRefThe graph each job runs.
schedulerequiredScheduleWhen the loop fires. Set exactly one of interval or cron.
suspendbooleanStops the schedule firing until set back to false. Jobs already created are not affected.
Default false.

Pattern ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{1,9})?Z$. Format date-time.
concurrencyConcurrencyHow many of the loop's jobs may be open at once.
jobTemplaterequiredJobTemplateWhat each job the loop creates is given.

GraphRef

The graph each job runs.

FieldTypeDescription
namerequiredstringThe Graph's metadata.name.
Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$.
revisionintegerPins a revision. Omitted means the latest revision each time the schedule fires.
At least 1.

Schedule

When the loop fires. Set exactly one of interval or cron.

Set exactly one of interval, cron.

FieldTypeDescription
intervalstringA fixed interval between runs, such as 1h.
Pattern ^(\d+d)?(\d+h)?(\d+m)?(\d+s)?$. At least 2 characters. From 1m to 365d.
cronstringA five-field cron expression, such as 0 9 * * 1-5.
Pattern ^\S+( \S+){4}$.
timeZonestringWith cron, the IANA time zone it is read in, such as Europe/Berlin.
Default UTC. Not empty. At most 64 characters.

Concurrency

How many of the loop's jobs may be open at once.

FieldTypeDescription
maxActiveJobsintegerThe most jobs from this loop that may be open at once.
Default 1. At least 1. At most 100.
overlapPolicystringWhen the schedule fires at the limit: Skip the run, or Queue one job to start when a slot frees.
Default Skip. One of Skip, Queue.

JobTemplate

What each job the loop creates is given.

FieldTypeDescription
goalrequiredstringWhat each job is for, in plain language.
Not empty. At most 20000 characters.
contextobjectNon-secret context for each job, such as a milestone. At most 64 keys.
At most 64 entries.
inputsmap[string]stringValues for the graph's inputs, by name, checked against the graph when the loop is applied.
Keys: Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$. At most 64 entries.
